instruction:
Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, create a two-storey apartment block containing four apartments, with an overall rectangular footprint of 22.0 m by 12.0 m near the project origin. The exterior wall envelope should rise about 6.3 m, include ground and upper slabs, and have a roof covering the footprint above Level 2. Provide two stairs near the centre of the plan that connect the two storeys. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, eighteen IfcSpace entities, eight IfcWall entities, two IfcSlab entities, one IfcRoof, eight IfcDoor entities, eight IfcWindow entities, and two IfcStair entities. Do not include IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include four Living Room spaces, four Kitchen spaces, four Bedroom spaces, four Bath spaces, and two Corridor spaces. Export a Revit room area schedule named result.csv with headers room name,area and exactly these rows: Bath A1=9.00, Bath B1=9.00, Bedroom A1=30.00, Bedroom B1=30.00, Corridor L1=66.00, Kitchen A1=9.00, Kitchen B1=9.00, Living Room A1=33.00, Living Room B1=33.00, Bath A2=9.00, Bath B2=9.00, Bedroom A2=30.00, Bedroom B2=30.00, Corridor L2=66.00, Kitchen A2=9.00, Kitchen B2=9.00, Living Room A2=33.00, and Living Room B2=33.00. Export a one-page Revit plan sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include A101 APARTMENT PLAN, Bath A1 A2, Bath B1 B2, Living Room A1 A2, and Living Room B1 B2. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
